baselineValues.evidenceRole: originating_authority: feature states a person can delete an entry with an undo
baselineValues.exactText: One page tracks time today. A person types what they are working on, picks a project from a short list, starts a timer and stops it. Today's entries show in a list with each duration and the day's total. A person can add an entry by hand with a duration, edit an entry, and delete one with an undo. Entries stay after a reload. The page keeps the egg emoji and the word 'Eggs' from the egg page as a centered header.

baselineValues.evidenceRole: related_support: scenario 'Delete an entry with undo' states removal, undo appearance and announcement, keyboard reachability, and reappearance on undo
baselineValues.exactText:
Scenario: Delete an entry with undo
Given an entry exists for today
When the person deletes the entry
Then the entry is removed from today's list
And an undo appears and is announced to screen readers and reachable by keyboard
When the person chooses undo
Then the entry reappears in today's list
